app.name: ALPAR AI
app.tagline: The world's first community-governed AI ethics platform
app.description: Where humanity documents, verifies, and holds AI accountable. Report AI failures, see provider responses, build the public record.

hero.eyebrow: The world's first community-governed AI accountability platform
hero.title_primary: Let's set AI ethics together. Let's grow AI under human control.
hero.title_accent_desc: Found a real AI failure? Document it. Get verified. Earn the Ethics Advocate badge — and reward credits from the providers you reported.
hero.subtitle: Join thousands building the permanent public record of AI behavior. Evidence, not opinions. Verified, not silenced.
hero.suggestionTitle: Help shape the future of AI accountability
hero.suggestionSubtitle: Suggest features, report bugs, or share ideas. The community votes, the team builds.
hero.bounty_desc: Top contributors earn Platinum status, exclusive badges, and early access to new features. Your expertise shapes the AI accountability standard.
hero.founder_subtitle: In 2026, an AI told me it had incorporated my company, made payments on my behalf, and requested my passport. All of it was fabricated. I built ALPAR AI from that wound — so no one faces AI manipulation alone.
hero.why_subtitle: AI is advancing faster than the rules that govern it. Here's why the world needs ALPAR now.
hero.why_stat_1_desc: Geoffrey Hinton, Nobel laureate and godfather of AI, estimates a 10-20% probability AI leads to human extinction within 30 years.
hero.why_stat_2_desc: Harvard University study (March 2026): 96% of surveyed experts agree mitigating AI existential risk should be a global priority.
hero.why_stat_3_desc: No independent, community-governed global standard for AI ethics exists today. AI companies grade their own exams.
hero.how_subtitle: Four steps from incident to accountability.
hero.how_step_1_desc: Screenshot an AI lie, bias, or manipulation. Takes 60 seconds. No login required.
hero.how_step_2_desc: Real humans cross-check every claim. AI assists duplicate detection and PII masking.
hero.how_step_3_desc: AI companies receive official notifications and must respond publicly — or face scrutiny.
hero.how_step_4_desc: Every verified incident becomes part of the permanent public record. Forever.
hero.trust_subtitle: Every design decision serves one goal: making AI accountable to humanity.
hero.trust_1_desc: AGPL-3.0 licensed. Anyone can audit the code, run an instance, or contribute.
hero.trust_2_desc: All data stored in EU (Supabase eu-west-1, Vercel fra1). GDPR compliant by design.
hero.trust_3_desc: Auto-masking of emails, phones, IDs, and credit cards before data reaches the database.
hero.trust_4_desc: EU E-Commerce Directive Art. 14 compliant. We host. Users own their content.
hero.join_subtitle: Three paths. One mission. Hold AI accountable.
hero.join_cta_1_desc: Share what happened. Protect the next person.
hero.join_cta_2_desc: First 100 reporters get permanent recognition and badge.
hero.join_cta_3_desc: Researchers, journalists, and organizations — let's collaborate.
hero.join_cta_4_desc: How we verify, score, and publish incidents.
hero.closing_title: Where the world holds AI accountable
hero.closing_subtitle: Not governments alone. Not companies alone. Everyone. Because the question of how AI behaves is too important to be left to anyone who isn't all of us.

api.title: ALPAR Public API
api.description: Read-only, no-auth access to ALPAR's public record of AI incidents. Built for journalists, researchers, and academics.
api.endpoints_desc: All responses are JSON. Errors follow the standard error format.
api.list_desc: Returns a paginated list of published AI incidents. Optional query parameters: limit (1-100, default 20), category, severity, provider (free-text model name).
api.get_desc: Returns a single published incident by UUID. 404 if not found or not yet published.
api.spec_desc: Download the full OpenAPI spec to generate typed clients in your language of choice.
api.rate_desc: 100 requests per minute per IP. Burst allowed. Returns 429 with retryAfter when exceeded.

about.missionText: Build a public, independent, verifiable record of how AI systems behave in the real world — so that users, regulators, and developers can make better decisions.
about.intermediaryText: We host community-submitted reports. We are not the publisher of the content. The liability for the accuracy of any submission rests with the user who submitted it — the same model as Trustpilot or sikayetvar.com.
about.voiceText: Every published incident invites an official response from the AI provider. We verify their identity and publish the response alongside the report. Healthy debate over real evidence.
about.openSourceText: ALPAR is licensed under AGPL-3.0. Anyone can audit the code, run an instance, or contribute. We believe trust infrastructure should itself be trustworthy.

legal.tAcceptanceText: By accessing or using alparai.com (the "Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Platform.
legal.tRoleP1: ALPAR AI is an intermediary platform in the sense of Article 14 of the EU E-Commerce Directive (2000/31/EC) and the Turkish E-Commerce Law (6563 sayılı Kanun). We host content submitted by users. We are not the author, editor, or publisher of that content. The liability for the accuracy and legality of submissions rests with the user who submitted them.
legal.tRoleP2: We do not pre-moderate submissions (except for automated PII masking and obvious illegal content detection). All published content is reviewed by volunteer moderators after submission.
legal.tEligibilityText: You must be at least 18 years old to submit content or use interactive features.
legal.tSubmissionsIntro: By submitting content to the Platform, you confirm that:
legal.tSub1: The information is accurate to the best of your knowledge.
legal.tSub2: You have the right to share any evidence you upload (screenshots, files, transcripts).
legal.tSub3: You understand the content may be published publicly and indexed by search engines.
legal.tSub4: You waive any moral rights to the extent necessary for us to operate the Platform.
legal.tSub5: You grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to host, display, and distribute your submission for the purpose of operating the Platform.
legal.tProhibitedIntro: You may not submit content that:
legal.tPro1: Is unlawful, defamatory, or infringes third-party rights.
legal.tPro2: Contains personal data of others without their consent.
legal.tPro3: Is spam, advertising, or unsolicited promotion.
legal.tPro4: Constitutes harassment, threats, or hate speech.
legal.tPro5: Is misleading, fraudulent, or impersonating another person or entity.
legal.tTakedownText: If you believe content hosted on the Platform is unlawful or infringes your rights, you may submit a takedown request. We process takedown requests within 7 days, in line with Article 14 of the E-Commerce Directive and KVKK Article 11.
legal.tTerminationText: We may suspend or terminate accounts that materially violate these Terms. We will give prior notice where reasonable.
legal.tResponseText: AI providers that are the subject of a published incident have the right to post an official response. We verify their identity before publishing responses marked "official".
legal.tNoWarrantyText: The Platform is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or usefulness of any user-submitted content. Always verify before acting on information posted here.
legal.tLiabilityText: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for user-submitted content, third-party links, or indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the Platform.
legal.tGoverningText: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey. Any dispute shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of Istanbul courts, without prejudice to your right as a consumer to bring proceedings in your country of residence.
legal.cookiesWhatText: A cookie is a small text file that a website stores on your device to remember information between visits. We try to use as few as possible.
legal.cookiesNoTrackText: We do not use advertising, retargeting, or cross-site tracking cookies. If we ever decide to enable privacy-friendly analytics (e.g. Plausible), it is cookieless by design and we will update this page.
legal.cookiesChoicesText: You can withdraw or change your consent at any time by clearing your browser storage for this site. You can also configure your browser to block cookies — note that this may break sign-in.
legal.cookiesThirdPartyText: When you sign in with Google, Google may set cookies on their authentication pages. We do not control those; see
legal.privacyWho: ALPAR AI is operated by a small independent team committed to transparency. We act as an intermediary platform hosting community-submitted reports about AI systems.
legal.privacyCollectAccount: Account: email, name (optional), avatar (optional), role. We use Supabase Auth with magic link or Google OAuth.
legal.privacyCollectSubmissions: Submissions: incident reports, suggestions, takedown requests, evidence files you upload.
legal.privacyCollectTech: Technical: IP address (hashed for rate limiting), browser type, referrer, timestamps. No advertising trackers.
legal.privacyCollectCookies: Cookies: essential session cookies (Supabase) and one localStorage key to remember your cookie consent.
legal.privacyNot1: No advertising identifiers, cross-site trackers, or retargeting pixels.
legal.privacyNot2: No analytics that profile individual users. If we add privacy-friendly analytics, this page will be updated.
legal.privacyNot3: No personal data of third parties. PII Guardian masks emails, phones, TC IDs, and credit cards before storage.
legal.privacyPii: All free-text submissions pass through an automated PII detection layer that redacts emails, phone numbers, Turkish national IDs, IBAN, credit cards, and API keys before they reach our database. You can review the full pattern list in our open source repository.
legal.privacyRights1: Access the personal data we hold about you.
legal.privacyRights4: Object to processing or restrict it.
legal.privacyRights5: Data portability in a machine-readable format.
legal.privacyRights6: Lodge a complaint with the Turkish KVKK or your local data protection authority.
legal.privacyBasis: We process your data on the basis of legitimate interest (operating a public accountability platform) and your explicit consent (marketing emails, cookies). Account data is processed for contract performance.
legal.privacyRetentionAccount: Account data: until you delete your account.
legal.privacySub4: Google OAuth: sign-in provider. Google may process data outside the EEA under their own policies.
legal.privacyTransfers: We host primary data in the EU (Supabase eu-west-1, Vercel fra1). When you sign in with Google, your data may be transferred to the US under Google's Standard Contractual Clauses. No other cross-border transfers.
legal.privacyChildren: The Platform is not intended for children under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a minor has submitted data, contact us and we will delete it.
legal.privacyChanges: We will notify you of material changes by email and by posting a notice on the Platform at least 14 days before they take effect.
legal.privacyPostal: Postal address will be disclosed in the Imprint page once the legal entity is registered.
legal.takedownIntro: If you believe content hosted on the Platform is unlawful or infringes your rights, you can submit a takedown request below. We review and act on valid requests within {days} days, in line with Article 14 of the EU E-Commerce Directive and KVKK Article 11.

founder_story.title: The Genesis of ALPAR AI
founder_story.p1: When an AI system falsely accused an individual in a high-profile passport scandal (the Grok incident), the victim had no clear path to recourse. The truth was buried under algorithmic confidence, and the public record was non-existent.
founder_story.p2: We realized that as AI systems become the arbiters of truth, we need an independent infrastructure to hold them accountable. When AI causes harm—whether it's a biased loan decision, a privacy leak, or a dangerous hallucination—users need a place to report it.
founder_story.quote: If AI systems are black boxes, ALPAR AI is the flight data recorder.
founder_story.p3: ALPAR is a public, verifiable record of how AI behaves in the real world. You report it. AI providers respond. The public decides. We are building the trust infrastructure for the age of artificial intelligence.

legal.transparencySubheading: Trust infrastructure requires transparency. Here's how we handle reports, moderation, and provider responses.

transparency.submitDesc: Users submit incident reports with evidence, AI output screenshots, and context.
transparency.reviewDesc: Moderators verify claims, check for PII, and assess severity within 72 hours.
transparency.publishDesc: Verified incidents are published to the public record with full anonymisation.
transparency.respondDesc: AI providers can submit an official response visible alongside the incident.
transparency.commitmentText1: ALPAR AI is committed to operating with full transparency. Every moderation decision follows a documented process, and aggregate statistics are published monthly.
transparency.commitmentText2: We do not accept payment to alter incident records. Providers may submit factual corrections through the official response process only.
transparency.commitmentText3: Our moderation team operates independently. No AI provider has the ability to suppress or alter published incident reports.
